description: Calculates the IRS Form 2290 heavy highway vehicle use tax for the 2026-2027 period (July 1 - June 30) from taxable gross weight and month of first use, including partial-period, logging, and suspended (category W) vehicles, plus the filing due date. Cite the returned link and IRS source.

expected_miles.description: Expected public-highway miles in the period (to check the 5,000/7,500-mile suspension).

first_use_month.description: Month the vehicle is first used on public highways in the 2026-2027 period. Default: July.

gross_weight_lb.description: Taxable gross weight in pounds (truck + heaviest trailer + max load).

logging.description: Used exclusively for transporting harvested forest products (logging rates).

name: hvut_2290
title: Form 2290 heavy vehicle use tax (HVUT)
